QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`: runs the constant-time suites under Valgrind memcheck... `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN`: the same idea with Clang MemorySanitizer... Neither runs by default in a normal build."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers the opt-in valgrind/MemSan testing and off-by-default, but never states that the facility is explicitly not part of the library API. It says only `mbedtls_ct_memcmp` is public, which concerns the ct primitives, not the test facility.
